mkdir -p /tmp/ostk-cache-smoke/.ostk && cat > /tmp/ostk-cache-smoke/.ostk/cache.toml <<'EOF'
port = 7777
mode = "rebuild"
soft_cap_mb = 25
[tail]
transcript = true
EOF
cd /tmp/ostk-cache-smoke && (cd /Users/scottmeyer/projects/ostk-cache && cargo run --quiet --bin ostk-cache -- --port 4242 --print-config 2>&1) | head -20

cd /Users/scottmeyer/projects/ostk-cache && \
  cargo build --quiet --bin ostk-cache 2>&1 | tail -3; \
  echo "=== TOML only ===" ; \
  ./target/debug/ostk-cache --config /tmp/ostk-cache-smoke/.ostk/cache.toml --print-config 2>&1 | head -6; \
  echo "=== TOML + env override ==="; \
  PROXY_PORT=5555 ./target/debug/ostk-cache --config /tmp/ostk-cache-smoke/.ostk/cache.toml --print-config 2>&1 | head -6; \
  echo "=== TOML + env + CLI override ==="; \
  PROXY_PORT=5555 ./target/debug/ostk-cache --config /tmp/ostk-cache-smoke/.ostk/cache.toml --port 4242 --print-config 2>&1 | head -6
